subject.title: improve(agents): exact web_fetch output contract with cleaned result shape

question: Should `web_fetch` now make `length` plus nested `spill` the sole stable model-facing contract, removing `wrappedLength` and flat spill fields for existing consumers?
rationale: This is an intentional public/model-facing contract change rather than a mechanical bug fix; maintainers must choose the supported upgrade and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept the canonical contract
options.body: Keep the proposed clean schema after provider-path and real-runtime proof demonstrate that all supported `web_fetch` results satisfy it.

options.title: Preserve a transition path
options.body: Retain or explicitly migrate the removed fields for a defined compatibility window if existing consumers are expected to depend on them.

recommendation.title: Accept the canonical contract
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed clean schema after provider-path and real-runtime proof demonstrate that all supported `web_fetch` results satisfy it.
